title: Blue Runway Coat & Striped Socks
prompt: An original young woman with long, tousled brown hair walks a runway in an oversized powder blue wool coat with toggle fastenings and large patch pockets. Beneath it, a dark brown pleated mini skirt with a textured knit overlay, sheer brown tights, and pale blue ribbed socks. She wears black pointed loafers with silver buckles. Her expression is calm and direct. A pale stone runway with warm wooden walls behind. Palette of powder blue, chocolate, and warm stone. Structured and cool, in the style of a winter runway editorial.
workingNotes:
- The powder blue coat and striped socks are the color anchors.
- Add 'mid-stride' to capture the walk.
